note: Names, descriptions and grades are shown as PlayStation publishes them. Every guide below is written in our own words; each cites the public guide it draws on, and no other guide's text is copied. Hidden flags follow the published lists (28 hidden: 1 gold, 27 bronze).

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 are yours, so there is no separate task to do for it. Work the list in order: story first, then the 100% checklist, then the leftover side quests. Budget around 200 hours for the full run at a relaxed pace.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui introduces Cal, he texts you and a purple icon marks a fishing spot. Follow his fishing questline and beat him at his own challenge — bring your best rod and mind the tension on the line.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. There are four video games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind on the TV at home (playable from Chapter 1), and Bang For Your Buck on arcade machines around the world. Finishing all the levels of any one of them pops it — you do not need to beat every challenge inside.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy's final mission. Her questline is Lucia-only and opens in Chapter 3, when Andy calls and texts her address in Belville. Five quests: Climbing the Cellerichain (three parts), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass. Everything stays available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's final mission. His questline opens in Chapter 1, a while after the Island Dreams mission — he calls, then a green KR icon marks his shop in Key Lento. He sends you diving for treasure in 7 shipwrecks; use the metal detector on the ocean floor and bring the finds back. Track it under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees. He goes quiet after Chapter 1 and returns in Chapter 2 or 3 — calling Brian as Jason in Chapter 2 speeds it up.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's final mission. His questline opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mud Club in Kelly County. Five quests: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes. All still available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands. Only certain questlines count — Kirk (the Skunk Ape hunt: Search for the Skunk Ape, Search for Tree Effigies, Help Kirk Find Mr. Mangrove), Kyle (McKittrick Farm, Collect Chemicals, Buddy?), Yago (Join a Street Race, Bumper to Bumper, Race Against Yago, Brother to Brother) and Pilot Pete (The Last Mile: Passing the Torch and Backseat Pilot, plus his deliveries) are confirmed. Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count. All strangers stay available in free roam after the story — but do Yago's Race Against Yago when it appears, as it may expire.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's final mission. His questline, Randy's Wish List, opens after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso and unlock the Key Cloner. He wants 16 high-end sports cars delivered to his garage in west Vice City (green RK icon). Scan cars with the WAiNK app to check them against his list — sports cars are thickest around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach — and deliver them in good condition for better pay. Track the list under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's final mission. Jason-only, opening after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty: purple markers point to Synthetic Labs in Vice City. Destroy the labs in Take Out Kitty Litter and Tyrone hands you Spin On This, shutting the labs down for good. Still available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots in 10 locations, and meditating with both Jason and Lucia at a spot counts double. Track them under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. THE missable one: during Chapter 1, after the Down to Earth mission, talk to Lucia in the kitchen at Jason's house one morning; she says she is going to meditate, walks to the balcony, and you follow and accept. That balcony meditation is gone for good after Chapter 1 — it is still unconfirmed whether it is required for the trophy, but doing it is the safe play. The 100% checklist only needs 15 of 18.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. His questline is Jason-only and opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when Bret texts you about Veteran Hunted in Lummox County. He hands you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69 (retrievable from any Ammu-Nation weapon locker) and marks hunting spots in purple; bring him the animals he asks for. His 15 Target Decks are all required for the 100% checklist, so this comes naturally.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. There are 18 sets hidden across Leonida — cards turn up in shops, houses and out in the world. Finish any three sets; you do not need all 18, though the 100% checklist wants 15 complete sets, so keep collecting.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Hold Up to open the WAiNK app, then hold R1 to scan landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and No Flusher tags as you pass them — 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures are marked, and there are more than 100 scannable objects in total, so any 100 will do.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. There are 80 in total and the 100% checklist needs 70, so this pops on the way — track them under Progress > Challenges and pick the easiest ones left when you are close. Most complete themselves while you chase the other trophies.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. You need both characters together, so this opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break — call your partner with hold Right + Triangle. Build 4 stars by causing chaos, then break out of the red heat zone on a fast sports bike; the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is a reliable escape route, as the helicopter cannot follow you there. It also pops by itself during the Chapter 4 bank-vault mission, which always triggers 4 stars.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. After Coffee Break, call your partner, then hit three robbery targets in a row while the flashing wanted level stays up — do not let it drop to the red heat level or clear. Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and healing items. The three jewelry stores in north Vice City (open after Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs) work well: loot a few items and crack the back-room safe in each. The pop is delayed by about half a minute after you leave the third shop, and if the police reach the first store before you leave, hit a fourth.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Open the WAiNK app (hold Up) and scan vehicles with R1 — you only need to scan them, not drive them. Stand on a busy road and scan everything that passes; 557 vehicles exist at launch, and the 100% checklist wants 200 base models scanned, so this comes early. Check totals under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3 + R3 while aiming: time slows and weak spots light up, draining the purple focus bar. Buff your focus first with food, drinks, a wash or a shower, and pop Adrenaline (L1, then Triangle) to stretch the window. Line up five gang-operation enemies and drop them with an assault rifle like the Duke 556 — it does not count against soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has four levels and rises through shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, so it gets easier as you play.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Steal a large passenger plane that is docked to a departure terminal — the ones parked on the airfield do not count. The easiest is at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence onto the airfield, take the stairs beside the boarding bridge straight into the plane, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse onto the strip and take off. Fly at least 1 km from the airport and it pops.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. Finish Gone Fishing, the opening mission of Chapter 1, and it pops as the mission ends.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete Chapter 1 and it unlocks as the first mission of Chapter 2 begins.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete Chapter 2 and it pops when Chapter 3 opens.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete Chapter 3; it unlocks after the first two missions of Chapter 4.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete Chapter 4; it pops at the end of the chapter's final mission, Starting From Zero.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy, gold. Finish the final mission of the game and this pops with the ending.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete Breakfast Run, a Chapter 2 story mission.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete The Cartel Heist, a Chapter 3 story mission.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete Child's Play, a Chapter 4 story mission.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete Headliners, a Chapter 4 story mission.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete VCIA Takedown, a Chapter 4 story mission.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy. Complete Operation Savage Glory, the Chapter 5 story mission.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The big one: reach 100% completion. The checklist opens after the story under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, and anything you did during the story already counts. It is far kinder than it sounds — closer to 60% true completion: most side quests are not required, and most collectibles are only partly required. In full you need every robbery, every underwater discovery, every shooting range, every drone race and every Bret quest, plus 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 100 optional missions and 70 of 80 challenges. Nothing on the list is missable, so clean it up in free roam after the story.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts of any kind. The map holds 397: 130 stunt jumps off ramps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps. Mix and match — flying under bridges is the fastest to rack up. Track them in Progress > Activities > Stunts, or on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots. The 100% checklist wants 300, so this pops on the way there.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a race (car, race challenge or drone race) and performing a stunt. Check Progress > Activities to see which you have done; most unlock naturally through the story and the other trophies, and blue dumbbell icons on the map mark activity spots.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across 12 ranges. Gold is not punishing — take your time, use each range's own weapons, and retry a challenge as often as you like. The ranges also raise your Focus level, which helps with Gunslinger.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations — 42 races in total, three per location. Learn each course's line first at low speed, then push for the win; the races are also required in full for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. The map has 40 unique race locations, so pick the shortest and easiest courses and work through them — each location only counts once, so keep moving to new ones.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank. The Rhinos sit in the south of Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County — drive through the gate or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, climb in and fire at the soldiers until it pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which unlocks the Snap Gun for silently picking alarmed doors and marks jewelry robberies in green. Enter through the back door — the prompt offers the Snap Gun or kicking the door (which trips the alarm) — then find the note with the safe code in the back room and loot the safe. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good first target.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe), which teaches the routine: tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open and rob it with your partner carrying a bag. After that, pay Yasmani $10,000 for security-van tips (after his two Payday Loan jobs) and he marks the vans in purple. There are 8 large bank jobs and the 100% checklist wants all of them; each pays up to $205,000 and instantly triggers 4 stars, so escape on a fast bike and swap cars to shake the heat.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The same Chapter 4 mission that teaches bank vaults counts — tailing the truck to the bank and robbing its vault qualifies. Earlier, you can also stop a truck driving near a bank in Vice City, block it, stick a bomb on its back door and blow it open, then escape the red heat radius. Sticky bombs are sold at the back of Yasmani's shop once his quests are done.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — fully unfog the map, all 52 areas. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every blacked-out patch until the whole map is visible.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 gang operations in total and the 100% checklist wants every one, but this trophy needs just one per gang. Operations show as yellow icons when you get close, and Progress > Gangs shows how many of each gang's operations you have hit.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a beachfront bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take in the view — the trophy's own description is the method. Guide sites still list the exact trigger as unconfirmed, so if it does not pop at the first bar, try the other beachfront spots along the strip.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Take a car into a vehicle showroom and drive it straight back out through the front glass — the 'classic style' is the old-school smash-and-grab exit. Guide sites still list the exact showroom and trigger as unconfirmed, so try the showrooms around Vice City.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley — steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations. It opens during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway office (blow it with sticky bombs). It pops after you escape the police, not when you grab the third item — and if you miss one, the robbery icon respawns later, so it is not missable.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal: reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength (heart icon). You need both characters, so this opens after Chapter 2's Coffee Break. Buy a gym membership and always train together — call your partner over and while one of you works out, the other trains automatically, doubling progress. Filter the map's Activities (dumbbell icon) for fitness clubs, or work out at home after the story.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. Turn on criminal-profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile) and watch for the demon-face icon whenever an action counts — stealthy objectives, destroyed evidence and clean getaways build a Professional profile; incapacitating enemies makes you Hardened; killing pushes you Violent, then Psycho; keep going and you become permanently Irredeemable, which makes cops far more aggressive, so avoid that. It builds passively through every robbery and fight, and the trophy list itself shows your count out of 500.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. Guide sites believe this one is tied to the Payday Loans store from the prologue — the idea being to go back and try the store's interaction a second time after failing it once. The exact trigger is still unconfirmed, so treat this as a lead, not a certainty.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? Guide sites believe this one comes from a UFO questline — keep an eye on the skies over Leonida at night and follow any strange lights or quest markers that appear. The exact trigger is still unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Guide sites believe this is a melee attack from a moving motorcycle — ride up to an enemy and kick them over without stopping. The exact trigger is still unconfirmed, so try the kick on pedestrians and gang members alike.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering marked bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer, then rob banks and Payday Loans and carry the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the best rate. The $250,000 is cumulative across all robberies; a single bank vault can pay up to $205,000.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest way to burn through it — Ammu-Nation, mod shops, tattoo studios, clothing, footwear, hair and beauty salons and electronics stores all count. It adds up naturally while you gear up for the other trophies.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — 8 purchasable garages (plus 4 story garages that do not count), $160,000 in total. They go on sale after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses), when the Vice City Real Estate app lands on your phone — buy them through the app. Robberies, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3 and 4, are the fastest way to fund them.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app arrives after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses), and Moses himself in Port Gellhorn does the registering — drive a stolen car to his garage and choose Respray, then Register. You need garage space first (see Little Boxes): each garage adds parking spots. Early on he only takes vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 he takes standard-tracker cars too, which you can also register at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registration costs money, so use cheap cars and bikes.
